mechanism: Levonorgestrel induces hepatic CYP2C9 and CYP3A4, increasing warfarin metabolism and reducing anticoagulant effect; conversely, warfarin may displace levonorgestrel from protein binding and increase contraceptive side effects.
action: Monitor INR closely with frequent testing; may require warfarin dose adjustment; consider alternative contraception (non-hormonal or progestin-only methods with less enzyme induction); counsel on breakthrough bleeding and contraceptive failure risk.
